findings.body: The new line `mod egress;` is inserted without a `#[cfg(feature = "voice")]` guard, unlike the surrounding modules. If the `voice` feature is disabled, the `egress` module (which likely depends on voice‑specific code) will still be compiled, leading to missing‑dependency errors or other compilation failures. Add the same `#[cfg(feature = "voice")]` attribute before the `mod egress;` declaration to keep it consistent with the other voice‑only sub‑modules.
findings.title: Guard egress module with voice feature flag

value.summary: The added egress module is not gated by the voice feature flag, which may cause compilation errors when the feature is disabled.
